description: go-ocpp is Voltbras's Go implementation of the Open Charge Point Protocol for electric-vehicle charging systems. It contains central-system and charge-point interfaces, request handlers and message logging. Version 1.5 uses SOAP and version 1.6 uses JSON over WebSockets. Inputs are protocol requests and connection settings; outputs are charging-system responses or protocol errors. The code has no fixed geographic coverage or simulation horizon, because those belong to the connected or emulated charging system. Source is free under GPL-3.0. A limitation is that the README leaves response-type assertions as an open implementation item and does not claim formal protocol certification. The library can support charging-system emulation and links between simulated chargers and control systems. The SAP smart-charging model (model-sap-emobility-smart-charging) provides related fleet scheduling. This is a protocol component, with no claim that it is a complete grid or vehicle simulator.
